versions.changelog:
okx-defi-portfolio 3.1.3

- Version bump to 3.1.3 (no code or documentation changes except version update).
- No functional changes; all commands, descriptions, and operation flows remain unchanged.

**Summary:** Improves routing logic for DeFi portfolio queries, ensuring correct skill usage when users mention specific DApps by name.

- Updated routing rules to use okx-dapp-discovery when the user names a specific third-party DApp (e.g. "my Aave positions").
- Clarified description and guidance to avoid using this skill for protocol-native views or explicit DApp requests.
- No changes to commands, chain support, or display rules.

- License updated from Apache-2.0 to MIT.
- Version bumped from 2.2.10 to 2.4.0 in the metadata.
- No file or functional changes detected; only metadata updates.

- Updated skill version to 2.2.10 (from 2.2.7) in metadata.
- No other file or functional changes detected.

- Improved documentation for commands, intent recognition, and display rules.
- Clearly distinguishes use cases for DeFi portfolio, wallet balances, DEX swap, and DeFi invest actions.
- New, comprehensive descriptions for supported chains, address resolution workflow, and parameter collection.
- Strict output formatting requirements for displaying portfolio and position details.
- Added tables for investType mappings, V3 Pool info, and post-execution suggestions.
